message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerabilities were confirmed as both fresh and relevant to the products in `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` during the 24-hour window from 2026-09-27 23:40 UTC to 2026-09-28 23:40 UTC (2026-09-28 05:10 IST to 2026-09-29 05:10 IST).

### Findings

No qualifying new vulnerabilities were found.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries and services.

No qualifying new MongoDB-family vulnerability was confirmed in the scan window. CERT-FR published a MongoDB roundup on September 28, but its underlying MongoDB and GitHub advisories were issued on September 24 and no clearly new vulnerability development was identified, so those items were excluded as stale for this run.

Sources checked: [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts); [CERT-FR advisory CERTFR-2026-AVI-1234](https://cert.ssi.gouv.fr/avis/CERTFR-2026-AVI-1234/).

### Freshness note

CVE-2026-100741 affecting hMailServer appeared in current search results, but its authoritative publication time was September 27 at 08:16 UTC, before this run's window began. It was therefore excluded rather than reported again.

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based on a newly reported in-window issue. Continue routine monitoring and normal remediation of previously disclosed vulnerabilities; this digest does not reassess older outstanding findings.
